purpose: research-only primary data collection for AI4WORK STEP needs analysis

record_rules.response_id: server-derived opaque SHA-256 from research_id + form_id + one-submit UUIDv4 idempotency key; raw idempotency key is never stored/exported
record_rules.recruitment_channel_id: MANDATORY_OPAQUE_FIRST_PARTY_BATCH_ID_CH_FORMAT; must identify only a documented dissemination batch and must never encode respondent, organisation, device, CRM/contact or tracking identity

php_candidate_binding.commercial_runtime_calls: FORBIDDEN_ON_RESEARCH_ROUTE; CRM/lead/mail runtimes are not invoked by research handler
php_candidate_binding.rights_controls: receipt lookup, bounded holds, live erasure, stale replay block and maximum-24-hour opaque replay-marker expiry
php_candidate_binding.test_twin: eucons/validation/test_php_research_runtime.php; synthetic engineering fixtures only; NON_EVIDENCE; no promotion path

candidate_hosting_processor_framework.processor_role: DPA states Claus Web generally acts as processor/subprocessor for shared hosting, VPS, dedicated hosting, cPanel/WHM and backup beneficiary data
candidate_hosting_processor_framework.security_framework: DPA describes risk-based Article 32 controls and ISO/IEC 27001-aligned governance, access control, logical segregation, network protection, logging/monitoring, vulnerability/change management, backup/recovery, incident response and secure deletion/decommissioning
candidate_hosting_processor_framework.subprocessors: general authorization exists, with categories including datacenter/colocation, hosting administration/licensing, backup/recovery, security/monitoring and domain registry/registrars; nominal Annex 4 list is available on request and must be account-verified
candidate_hosting_processor_framework.international_transfers: DPA states beneficiary data will not be transferred outside the EEA without a valid Chapter V GDPR mechanism
candidate_hosting_processor_framework.residual_backup: DPA expressly preserves residual technical backup retention according to Annex 5; Annex 5 values are available on request and must be account-verified
candidate_hosting_processor_framework.public_shared_hosting_product_observatio: current provider product information advertises daily backups with 7-day retention plus 3 monthly copies for shared hosting; this is not yet proven to be the exact eucons.ro plan
candidate_hosting_processor_framework.datacenter_public_observation: provider states it uses GTS Telecom data center infrastructure in Bucharest, Romania

production_binding_requirements: freeze and approve the actual controller determination before any provider/controller binding is claimed
prove the actual eucons.ro hosting account/order is the Claus Web service covered by the reviewed DPA
obtain/retain the applicable DPA/contract acceptance evidence for the determined controller or the legally documented party authorized to instruct the processor
document the legal relationship between the determined controller, the hosting-account holder and Claus Web
obtain and verify current nominal Annex 4 subprocessor list for the actual service
obtain and verify Annex 5/account-specific backup retention and deletion/restore behavior
provider-bound prove research root is outside document root and separate from commercial EUCONS_DATA_ROOT
HTTPS endpoint with CORS limited to https://eucons.ro and https://www.eucons.ro
server-side schema and direct-identifier validation before persistence
retry-safe idempotency preserving one analytical row per submit attempt
bind each accepted response to an opaque recruitment_channel_id from the frozen approved channel register without referrer/UTM/cookie/IP/device/CRM tracking
verify encryption in transit and document at-rest controls available on actual provider plan
role-based access limited to designated research staff
verify actual reverse-proxy/application logging and retention so request bodies/raw idempotency keys are not logged and IP/device metadata never enters analytical exports
bind the approved retention schedule to live storage and provider backup rotation and prove deletion execution and 24h maximum replay-marker expiry
immutable raw export with SHA-256 before analytical cleaning
browser-to-HTTP-to-store-to-export-to-NF06 provider-bound TEST TWIN smoke must PASS before real collection

repository_validation.status_rule: exact-head CI must be green after the last code change; repository success never substitutes for provider-bound production validation
